component.name: Quadra
component.summary: Play Roblox on Linux with the macOS client
Roblox на Linux через клиент для macOS

description.p: Quadra runs the official macOS Roblox client on Linux through Darling, with fixes for graphics, input, sound and performance. The launcher keeps the client up to date and has settings for fast flags, DNS and diagnostics.

Quadra запускает официальный клиент Roblox для macOS на Linux через Darling и чинит графику, ввод, звук и производительность. Лаунчер сам обновляет клиент, в нём есть настройки фастфлагов, DNS и диагностика.
Created by Narezany; this version is maintained by aubree.wtf.
Создал Narezany; эту версию поддерживает aubree.wtf.
Quadra is not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.
Quadra не связан с Roblox Corporation.
Fixes the camera continuing to turn after the right mouse button is released when the left button was clicked during a right-button drag.

Removes the roughly 18 second menu freeze after leaving a game by making the game's I/O loops look at their queues every 100 milliseconds. Updates Quadra M2VK with memory priority, a settings tab, a startup self-test with OpenGL fallback and better diagnostics, and adds a stall watcher and richer hardware report for bug reports.

Repairs public Roblox download recovery when an alternate server reports a missing upload, rate limit or temporary server error after HTTP 403. Adds a website bug-report guide and a public GitHub form requiring the matching diagnostics archive.

Keeps setup and routine Roblox update checks on the public release channel. Fixes native Wayland copy and paste with rich text views and Unicode, and explains unavailable OverlayFS support before startup. Adds NixOS packaging and live Darling status in the launcher. Native Metal packages also refresh shared-memory GPU budgets and limit resident shader preloads.

Redesigns the launcher with square controls and a grid backdrop, plus saved choices for classic GNOME and aubree.lat monochrome. Retries blocked Roblox deployment downloads on alternate official servers. Fixes Shift Lock centering and camera capture interrupted by switching windows, and bounds native Quadra M2VK graphics budgets on shared-memory GPUs.

Adds experimental Metal on Vulkan rendering with a prebuilt bridge in native distro packages. Fixes the Metal layer compositor crash and preserves clean switching back to OpenGL. Verified with Write a Letter on native Wayland and NVIDIA. VR continues to require OpenGL or Zink.

Rebrands Cider to Quadra / QuadraHQ at quadrahq.org while preserving the logo and migrating existing user data. Retries public Roblox deployment downloads through the Quadra cache after HTTP 403. Preserves captured right-drag camera motion when left-click is pressed, and records severe FPS drops for diagnosis. The intermittent FPS drop remains under investigation.

Adds experimental VR: Roblox's own VR mode on a headset through an OpenXR runtime such as WiVRn (Meta Quest) or Monado, with head tracking, controllers, vibration and recentering, configured in the new VR settings tab. Fixes duplicated typing and an unreliable Control key with native Wayland.

Supports Roblox 0.743.0.7431134, warns when Roblox selects a transport other than RakNet, and applies initial fullscreen requests to native Wayland windows. The brief pause after leaving a game remains under investigation.

Repairs Error 256 when joining Roblox 0.743 with verified RakNet transport compatibility. Keeps the cursor visible during right-button camera dragging on Wayland and X11. Arch, Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora packages include these fixes.

Fixes native Wayland startup and game-join freezes, aligns mouse clicks with the cursor, and repairs outer window resizing. The launcher backend option is now named Wayland. Arch, Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora packages include the fixes.
New CiderHQ logo, runtime selection, server detection and installer compatibility fixes.
Cider rebrand, multi-monitor mouse lock, Roblox 0.742 GLSL and credential-free Darling builds. Source release; no Flatpak bundle.

Repairs custom UI scale input handoffs and X11 locked-pointer fallback/recentering. Uses the selected cursor bitmap for the locked-cursor overlay. Adds verified transport compatibility for Roblox 0.742 and transport diagnostics in launch logs. Includes native Wayland cursor decoding fixes and distro package recipes. Gameplay confirmation on reporting systems is pending; whole-game freezes and reported connection errors remain under investigation. This is a source-only release; no Flatpak bundle is published.

Repairs required-update loops across Roblox deployment channels, adds audio playback fallback for older PipeWire versions, and improves cursor positioning during mouse lock. Prevents optional Darling Swift SDK downloads from prompting for Git credentials. The published 0.21 release contains source only; Freedesktop 26.08 packaging remains experimental.

Repairs keyboard labels used by interaction prompts, compensates mouse coordinates for custom UI scaling, improves camera confinement and text input, and adds GPU selection. Adds crash diagnostics and improves rendering and startup stability. The published 0.20 release contains source only.

Fixes invisible X11 cursors with Vulkan (Zink), removes unnecessary serialization of independent DNS lookups, and adds adjustable Roblox UI scaling from 100–400%. Improves Flatpak graphics discovery and Vulkan error messages. Repairs experimental Wayland EGL drawables, window lookup and NVIDIA driver discovery. The leave-game pause remains unresolved; Native Wayland and Zink remain experimental. Direct client Vulkan and custom Darlingserver experiments are not included.

Adds a welcome and first-time setup guide. Fixes raw mouse and camera freezes, restores mouse capture after focus changes, repairs Private Servers rendering crashes, and improves Zink context and shader compatibility. Reduces Darling file-close cleanup delays and keeps process cleanup within the selected app environment. A later pause after leaving games remains under investigation. Native Wayland and Zink remain experimental.

Restores the standard GNOME interface. Adds an experimental Vulkan renderer through Mesa Zink and an optional MangoHud overlay for OpenGL and Vulkan. Improves cursor visibility during camera capture, contended locks, shader compatibility and persistent GPU caching. Fixes Linux builds failing because dsymutil is unavailable.

A new launcher interface: a dark desktop with a console that shows what is installed and ready. Raw mouse input for the camera, Discord Rich Presence, playtime, mods (sounds, cursors, fonts), a log viewer with search, and Play links from the browser. Fixes for freezes when leaving a game and when quitting.

Signing in with a password and other embedded pages open in the launcher's own browser window. Microphone for voice chat. New app ID org.ciderhq.Cider. Fixes for a Fedora KDE crash loop, for Darling's thread stacks, and for the Flatpak failing with "Cannot determine your user name".
Fixes for freezes, stutter, audio dropouts and slow loading, and the Roblox sign-in cookie is only sent to Roblox.
